7685095.variantName: Habitat 7ft Pre Lit Pencil Christmas Tree
7685095.sourceDescription: Transform your space with a Christmas tree that brings festive magic without taking over the room. This 7ft pre-lit tree has a slim pencil shape that fits into narrow corners and hallways with ease, making it a brilliant choice when floor space is tight. It's already threaded with 180 warm white lights that glow softly throughout the realistic branches, so there's no wrestling with tangled fairy lights or hunting for plug sockets. The tree comes with its own metal stand and needs minimal assembly to get it looking perfect. Just pop it up, plug it in and let the warm glow set the festive mood from the moment you switch it on. . yv2af1ew.sourceDescription: The hinged Christmas tree boasts a full look with densely arranged branch tips. Crafted from 100% new flame-retardant and smell-less PVC, this pre-lit Xmas tree ensures both safety and freshness throughout the season. Its hinged branches unfold smoothly to shape a natural, verdant silhouette, complemented by a folding metal stand featuring a pre-installed bolt for secure, precise alignment. The pencil Christmas tree’s section design enables quick and straightforward assembly. Ideal for cozy corners or smaller areas, this artificial Xmas tree brings holiday cheer without compromising space. The section configuration simplifies the process, helping you decorate faster and enjoy the season sooner. Upgraded Metal Stand: The metal base of the hinged Christmas tree features a pre-installed bolt for quick and precise alignment. Protective foot pads help prevent scratches on flooring, and the foldable structure makes storage more convenient once the holidays are over. Space-saving Pencil Tree: Featuring a narrow pencil shape, the pre-lit Xmas tree provides height and elegance without occupying much floor space. It is ideal for apartments, offices, or retail environments, offering a refined decorative touch suitable for both festive celebrations and everyday ambiance. vkjcf79m.baseName: COSTWAY 2FT Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with LED Light - Green
vkjcf79m.variantName: COSTWAY 2FT Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with LED Light - Green
vkjcf79m.sourceDescription: Add a Joyful Christmas Atmosphere to Your Dining Table! This mini Christmas tree is a perfect choice for decorating the tabletop, mantel, windowsill, kitchen, bedroom, wedding, themed party, and more, adding festival charms to anywhere you want. And it can also be a great gift for your family, friends, or colleagues. Designed with 75 snowy branches and 8 cute pine cones, this artificial mini Xmas tree looks vivid and natural from near to far. Moreover, it features 50 warm-white LED lights in 8 lighting modes, which can not only illuminate your Christmas night, but also allow you to enjoy charming lighting shows at home. If you are looking for a mini Christmas tree like this, do not hesitate to place an order! Natural and Vivid Appearance: This 64cm artificial tabletop Christmas tree features 75 verdant branch tips with snow spraying, helping create a full-bodied and vivid appearance. Moreover, 8 realistic pine cones are evenly scattered on the branches to enliven the holiday atmosphere. Charming Lighting Shows: The pre-lit small Christmas tree is designed with 50 warm-white LED lights, providing romantic vibes and bright appeals. And there exist 8 beautiful lighting modes for you to choose from according to your preference. Besides, the lights are powered by 3 AA batteries (not included). Durable Material and Stable Structure: These leaves are crafted with 100% new PVC material that can not only make the tree look more realistic but also is non-odor, non-allergic and flame-retardant, ensuring safety during use. In addition, it is supported by a sturdy cement base to keep the tree stable all the time. No Assembly and Maintenance Required: The light up mini Xmas tree requires no assembly, but you need to take some time on fluffing the tree to get a fuller tree shape. More than that, in contrast to real plants, this artificial Xmas tree requires no watering, pruning, fertilizing, or sunlight. Besides, the unsightly base is covered by exquisite burlap. Perfect Tabletop Decoration: The small and exquisite Christmas tree measures 40 x 64cm (Dia. x H) and only weighs about 1kg, which is lightweight and portable for decorating anywhere you want. It is ideal for the dining table, mantel table, windowsill, show window, writing desk, nightstand, and more. Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC, cement, burlap Overall dimensions: 40 x 64 cm (Dia. x H) Diameter of the cement base: 8 cm Number of branch tips: 75 Number of pine cones: 8 Number of LED lights: 50 Net weight: About 1 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Package includes: 1 x Tabletop mini Christmas tree Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

kqhqjdtm.variantName: COSTWAY 75 cm Pre-Lit Mini Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree-Green
kqhqjdtm.sourceDescription: This festive tabletop piece brings cheerful character and practical glow to seasonal spaces. Styled with a Santa-inspired red hat, soft white nose, and red glove accents, it creates the charm of a decorated Christmas tree while fitting neatly on desks, mantels, and entry tables. With 105 snowy PVC branch tips, the silhouette looks fuller and more textured, adding a cozy winter touch without taking up much room. The 20 warm white LED lights give this pre-lit small Xmas tree a welcoming sparkle, and 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) make it easy to match quiet evenings or lively holiday gatherings. Battery-powered design supports flexible placement, while the timer function runs 6 hours on and 18 hours off for everyday convenience. Premium PVC tips are flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic, making this mini tabletop Christmas tree a dependable indoor decoration for homes, offices, kids, and pets. Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included. Note: The decorations are not included. Festive Character Design: This 75 cm mini tabletop Christmas tree features a Santa-inspired look with a classic red hat, a soft white nose, and bright red glove accents, creating a playful holiday focal point. With 105 snowy PVC branch tips, it also adds layered texture and a realistic snow-kissed finish. Pre-Lit Design: With 20 warm white LED lights and 8 lighting modes, this pre-lit Christmas tree creates a bright, inviting glow that brings festive charm to the room. Battery operation makes it easy to move around, while the built-in timer function provides 6 hours on and 18 hours off for added convenience. Trusted Indoor Material: Crafted with premium PVC leaves, this mini realistic Xmas tree is flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic for dependable indoor decorating. It provides added peace of mind for kids, pets, and everyone you love. Hassle Free Assembly: This small Xmas tree is easy to set up - simply attach the stand and fluff the branch tips for a fuller look. Its compact structure also makes post-season storage easier, which is especially helpful for smaller family spaces. Versatile Display Spot: This charming faux tabletop Xmas tree is ideal for small-space decorating and adds festive presence without overwhelming the room. It works beautifully on entry tables, mantels, office desks, shelves, and side counters, making it a flexible accent wherever holiday spirit is needed.
